data.name: Help_WhatBody
data.value: Pairing an audiobook with its text means finding, for every sentence, the moment it is spoken. The phone works that out itself: it listens to short samples and looks up what it heard in the book’s own text. Nothing is sent anywhere.

data.name: Help_LiveBody
data.value: Measures the passage you are on, from where the narration is, while the reader is open. Nothing to wait for — the text starts following within seconds — but only for what you actually read.

data.name: Help_AheadBody
data.value: Works through the whole book in the background so it is ready before you get there. This is the one the settings below are about.

data.name: Help_PresetThrifty
data.value: Two threads on the efficiency cores, a quarter of the time. You will barely notice it — and it is by far the slowest.

data.name: Help_PresetBalanced
data.value: Four threads on the efficiency cores, half the time. The phone stays smooth for everything else while it works.

data.name: Help_PresetFast
data.value: Every core, no pauses. Several times faster than the other two, and the phone will get warm.

data.name: Help_PresetChangeNote
data.value: Switching presets only takes effect after you stop and restart alignment — it does not change a run already under way.

data.name: Premium_Title
data.value: You already have Premium Pro Plus!

data.name: Premium_Body
data.value: Because everything in this app is free. Always was, always will be.

data.name: Help_SlowerSection
data.value: Why it can be slower than the estimate

data.name: Help_SlowerHeat
data.value: Heat. The moment the system reports the phone warming, the app eases off on its own — first to seven tenths of the pace, then further, and it stops outright if the phone gets hot. That is deliberate: pushing through a warm phone does the same work at half speed and keeps it warm.

data.name: Help_SlowerCores
data.value: A sleeping phone. Work carries on with the screen off — the app holds the processor awake for it — but Thrifty and Balanced only ever use the efficiency cores, and an idle phone runs those at their lowest speed. That is why they can crawl in a pocket while Fast keeps going.

data.name: Help_DoneCharging
data.value: Fast, with “only while charging” and “only while the screen is off”, overnight. That is what those two switches in Settings are for.

data.name: Help_DoneReading
data.value: Or do not wait at all: open the reader and read along with the narration. Alignment while reading measures exactly the passage you are on, and the rest of the book can finish whenever it likes.

data.name: Help_PausedSection
data.value: When it stops on its own

data.name: Help_PausedBody
data.value: The notification always says why: waiting for a charger, waiting for the screen to go off, or the battery is under the limit you set. Nothing is lost — unplugging for ten minutes costs ten minutes, not the chapter.

data.name: Delete_AlsoFileNote
data.value: Removes it from the phone, not just from this library. There is no way back.

data.name: Delete_FileKept

data.name: Delete_FileRefused

data.name: Dialog_ClearBody

data.name: Reader_TranslateAction

data.name: Reader_BookmarkAction
data.comment: Button offered after selecting text in the reader.

data.name: Details_LiveAlignmentNote
data.value: Measures the passage you are reading, while you read it. Nothing to wait for.

data.name: Details_AlignAheadNote
data.value: Works through the whole book in the background, so it is ready before you get there.

data.name: Settings_RecognitionBody
data.value: Which speech model listens to the book. A better one mishears less, so fewer stretches are thrown away and left to be guessed at — which is what makes the text sit closer to the voice.

data.name: Recognition_TinyDetail
data.value: The small model, about 31 MB. What the app has used until now.

data.name: Recognition_BaseDetail
data.value: The next size up, about 58 MB. Around three times longer to align, and noticeably better at languages other than English. Downloaded the first time you align with it.

data.name: Settings_SpacingBody
data.value: How often the book is sampled while aligning ahead of time. Does not affect measuring while you read -- that always works its own way regardless of this.

data.name: Spacing_60Detail
data.value: Samples every 60 s. What the app ships with, and the least CPU time of the four; on a synthetic narrator this left the widest gap for interpolation to guess across.

data.name: Spacing_45Detail
data.value: Samples every 45 s. About a third more work than the default.

data.name: Spacing_30Detail
data.value: Samples every 30 s. Twice the work of the default. The only step past it that has actually been measured on real hardware.

data.name: Spacing_15Detail
data.value: Samples every 15 s. Four times the work of the default. Whether a real book's accuracy actually improves this far has not been measured -- only the jump from 60 s to 30 s has.

data.name: Settings_WordTimesNote
data.value: Asks the model when each word was spoken instead of assuming an even pace across a few seconds. More precise wherever the narrator pauses mid-sentence. Turn it off if aligning gets slower on your phone.
